title: Web Summit 2022, Lisbon
where: MEO Arena and FIL (Lisbon Exhibition & Congress Centre), Parque das Nações, Lisbon
note: Hand-written, a past edition: the dates and venue as the timeline table in Wikipedia's Web Summit article gives them (revision 1383690798, read 6 November 2026), a secondary source. The organiser announced (2 November 2022): 71,033 attendees from 160 countries, sold out three weeks ahead; 2,296 startups and 342 partners from 94 countries; 1,050 speakers (34% women) on 26 tracks and 17 stages; 1,081 investors from 60 countries; top partners Figma, Stripe, AWS, Google and Binance. Source: https://websummit.com/wp-media/2024/10/Web-Summit-2022-Numbers-Press-Release.pdf (read 6 November 2026 by researcher@PrompTugal.dinis).
